title: 天鹅湖 · 展翼与湖面滑行
authorship: Original JC04 joint-space choreography, authored for this project.
interpolation: Piecewise quintic pose score; dense CSV playback uses a degree-five spline with C2 endpoints.

music_timing.anchor_method: Acoustic envelope and spectrogram phrase candidates; not manually verified beat annotations.

leg_geometry: Each side keeps knee minus hip at 60.7787 degrees; common leg offsets preserve support orientation.

sections.name: 展翼
sections.description: Low scoops unfold into long forward reaches, then folded wings open into the first high arc over a broad plié.

sections.name: 滑行与屈伸
sections.description: Gathered elbows open into high forward reaches; deep pliés alternate with extension during a long glide and sweeping retreat.

sections.name: 左右应答与弧线
sections.description: One wing crowns while the other reaches forward or folds; the diagonals exchange through two broad wheel-driven curves.

sections.name: 渐强飞翔
sections.description: A deep gather releases into forward flight, alternating high diagonals and wide wings; a final plié prepares the crown.

sections.name: 天鹅高展
sections.description: Both wings reach their highest overhead crown as the legs extend and the wheels come to rest.

sections.name: 舒缓回落
sections.description: High and forward wings answer across retreating counter-curves, gathering once more before a final forward offering and open-wing release.

sections.name: 谢幕
sections.description: Gathered elbows and forward arms deepen into a sustained plié, then lower together into the standing pose and final stillness.
